title: Bank connections
intro: Connect your company's account to bring its statement and balance into Finanças. The money stays in your bank; CTech holds no balance.

providerBlurb.inter: Inter Empresas business account: statement, balance and, soon, Pix charges.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.body: You need an Inter Empresas (business) account. The integration is created at Inter by an administrator of the account in Internet Banking.

create_integration.title: Create the integration at Inter
create_integration.body: In Internet Banking, open Integrar and choose Nova integração. There are three parts:

details.title: Nova integração.
details.body: Enter the name (up to {{nameMax}} characters; suggestion: {{name}}) and the description (up to {{descriptionMax}} characters).

scopes.title: Escopos.
scopes.body: Under “Quais atividades pretende realizar?”, tick only the five below and, inside each, all of these permissions (the recurrence, extra Pix and boleto ones are not used yet, but they save you a second integration later):

create_integration.noPayments: Under Pagamentos, tick only the webhooks: do not tick Pix, bill or tax payments. Do not tick Forum Inter.
create_integration.terms: Also tick “Li e concordo com todos os Termos e condições de uso das APIs”.

questionnaire.title: Inter's questions.
questionnaire.body: On the account's first integration Inter asks for more steps (Sobre a sua empresa, Sobre seus clientes and Revisão). They do not appear on later ones.

validation.title: Wait for the validation
validation.body: Inter reviews the integration and tells you by e-mail. Meanwhile another one cannot be created.

download.title: Download the key and certificate
download.body: Under Integrar, the new integration shows with the status “Novo”. Click it to download the key and certificate: a zip with two files, .crt and .key. The client_id and client_secret show on screen only once and are not in the zip: copy them now.

webhook.title: Payment webhook
webhook.body: Comes with charging through Inter. The connection already brings the statement and the balance.

form.accountHint: Digits only, with the check digit, no leading zeros.
form.pixKeyHint: Optional. We recommend a random key used only by CTech: Inter's payment webhook is one per key.
form.notifyEmailHint: Certificate and connection notices go to this address.
form.authorize: I declare this integration belongs to my company and I authorize CTech to use it on our behalf to read the statement and issue charges.
form.wrongType: Send the .crt, .key or .pem file downloaded from Inter

sandbox.title: Test mode
sandbox.body: In test mode, CTech uses its own integration with Inter's test environment. None of your data is needed.
sandbox.busy: Inter's test environment is busy. Try again in a moment.
sandbox.unavailable: Inter's test environment may be unavailable.

screen.subject: Holder
screen.renewBanner: The Inter certificate expires on {{date}}. Renew it in Internet Banking and send the new pair.
screen.expiredBanner: The Inter certificate expired. The statement stopped syncing until you send the new pair.
screen.degradedBanner: The last attempts to reach Inter failed. Test the connection; if the integration was cancelled at Inter, connect again or disconnect.
screen.backfilling: Bringing the statement history. It may take a few minutes.
screen.missingScopes: To charge through Inter, the integration lacks these permissions: {{scopes}}
screen.tooSoon: Synced moments ago. Try again in a few minutes.
screen.renewBody: Send the new certificate and the new key downloaded from Inter. The client_id and client_secret stay the same.
screen.connected: Account connected. We are bringing the statement.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Banco Inter?
disconnect.body: CTech deletes the credentials and stops syncing. The history in Finanças stays, read-only.
disconnect.onlyYou: Only you can cancel the integration at Inter: Internet Banking, Integrar, the integration, Cancelar. Cancelling cannot be undone.
disconnect.openCharges: There are {{count}} open charges. Disconnecting cancels all of them.
disconnect.openCharges_one: There is 1 open charge. Disconnecting cancels it.
disconnect.anywayBody: Inter did not answer. If you disconnect anyway, remove the charges and the webhook below at Inter yourself.

unclassified.title: To classify
unclassified.emptyBody: New bank entries appear here until you say what they are.
unclassified.difference: Difference of {{amount}} between Inter and Finanças
unclassified.noBills: No open bill with this amount

bulk.title: Classify in bulk
bulk.mixed: Money in and money out together can only go to a transfer. Select only one kind to choose a category.
bulk.confirmBody: All of them will be classified as {{target}}. They are sent one by one and you follow the progress.

collection.title: Collection through Inter
collection.intro: Invoices get a Pix with a due date, paid straight into your Inter account. Fine and interest apply to the Pix of every invoice issued from now on.
collection.active: This organization's invoices are collected by Pix with a due date at Inter.
collection.fineHint: From 0 to 20%, charged once after the due date.
collection.interestHint: From 0 to 10% a month, per calendar day late.
collection.needsCollection: To collect, the integration needs the collection scopes (cobv, pix and webhook).

pix.title: Pix with due date
pix.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it.
pix.simulated: Payment simulated in the sandbox. The invoice is confirmed in a moment.
pix.excessBody: We received {{amount}} more on this invoice. The money is in your account; refund it if needed.
pix.refundBody: Inter sends the amount back by Pix to whoever paid. This cannot be undone.

webhook.title: Payment webhook
webhook.registered: Webhook registered: Inter tells CTech about every Pix paid.
webhook.notRegistered: No webhook: confirmations arrive within an hour.
webhook.overwritten: Another system now receives this key's webhooks. Confirmations arrive within an hour.
webhook.conflictTitle: Another system receives this key's webhooks
webhook.conflictBody: This Pix key's payment webhooks go to {{host}}. If CTech registers its own, that system stops receiving them. Better use a random key (EVP) for CTech only.
webhook.replaceBody: {{host}} stops receiving this Pix key's payment webhooks. Do it only if that system no longer needs them.

collection.title: Cobranças
collection.hint: Issue boletos with or without Pix.

permission.due_charge_write: Emitir e editar cobranças com vencimento
permission.charge_write: Emitir e editar cobranças imediatas e retiradas(saque e troco)
permission.due_batch_write: Permissão para alteração de lotes de cobranças com vencimento
permission.due_batch_read: Permissão para consulta de lotes de cobranças com vencimento
permission.recurrence_request_write: Criar e editar solicitações de recorrência
permission.recurring_charge_write: Emitir, editar e retentar cobranças recorrentes
permission.recurrence_payload_write: Criar e editar payloads de recorrência
permission.recurrence_webhook_write: Criar e editar webhooks de recorrências
permission.recurring_charge_webhook_write: Criar e editar webhooks de cobranças recorrentes
permission.boleto_read: Consultar cobranças e exportar para PDF

pixKey.title: Change Pix key
pixKey.body: The Pix key charges are issued on. Inter sends payment webhooks to one address per key: use a random (EVP) key of CTech's own so another system does not lose its webhooks.
pixKey.label: New Pix key
pixKey.conflictDone: Key changed. Another system receives this key's webhooks: see below and confirm if you want to replace it.
pixKey.openCharges_one: {{count}} charge is still open on the current key. Wait for it to be paid or cancel it before changing the key.
pixKey.openCharges_other: {{count}} charges are still open on the current key. Wait for them to be paid or cancel them before changing the key.
